sequenceDiagram
    participant BZ as Bergzicht purchasing
    participant VAN as EDI provider
    participant OMS as Order record
    participant WMS as WMS at Duiven
    participant ERP as ERP
    BZ->>VAN: ORDERS 240 units 18 SKUs
    VAN->>OMS: order created, channel EDI
    OMS->>WMS: fulfillment order
    WMS->>WMS: pick, pack, print SSCC per pallet
    WMS->>VAN: DESADV from pack confirmation
    VAN->>BZ: DESADV before the truck arrives
    WMS->>ERP: shipment confirmed
    ERP->>VAN: INVOIC from shipment and price list
    VAN->>BZ: INVOIC, payment due in 30 days
